blocks.html: Once you own or join a feed, the dashboard is where you add content and keep it in sync.

slides.title: Open the feed dashboard
slides.html:
Tap a feed to open its dashboard.

  • The tools across the top are Add Items, Timeline, Download, Feed Settings and Search.
  • Items are grouped into Map Items, Photos and Files.

slides.title: Add items to a feed
slides.html:
Tap Add Items, then choose how to add: Map Select, Overlays, File Select or User Log.

  • The same menu has Invite (add teammates) and Geofence — anyone whose marker crosses a feed's geofence is invited automatically.

slides.title: Update shared items
slides.html:
Move or edit a shared item and you're asked to publish the change.

  • Changed items show in red; tap Mark Read to clear them.
  • If two people edit the same item offline, a deconfliction prompt lets you keep the version you want.

slides.title: Delete or unsubscribe a feed
slides.html: Tap Delete on a feed and choose Unsubscribe (stop updates, keep content), Delete local content, or Delete from server (owners only). Slide both switches to the locked position, then confirm.
